info.title: VMEG Open API (App-Synced)
info.description:
Same protocol as the Standalone API, but every task, material, and cloned voice lives in your VMEG website account: jobs show up in **My tasks**, open in the editor, and can be re-exported. Poll `GET /openapi/v1/app/tasks/detail` for results (no webhooks). See [Standalone vs App-Synced](/guides/choose-api).

Linked guides are written for the Standalone API. The steps are the same; use the `/openapi/v1/app` prefix instead of `/openapi/v1`.

tags.name: Media translation
tags.description: Translate and dub uploaded video/audio or a YouTube link on the same pipeline as vmeg.ai. The first pass renders the dubbed file; the job also appears in **My tasks** for editing and re-export. Poll [Query job status](/api-reference/app-synced/tasks/get-task-detail) for results.

tags.name: Voice clone
tags.description: Clone a voice from a short recording. The voice is saved to **My voices** on the website and returned as `cv_*` for translate-and-dub jobs.

tags.name: Task management
tags.description: List, inspect, or delete the video/audio translation jobs in your VMEG account, including jobs created on the website.

tags.name: Assets - Materials
tags.description: Upload and manage the files in your website material library (**My assets**). Finish the upload (single-file or multipart), then pass `materialId` to create-async.

tags.name: Assets - Voices
tags.description: List preset system voices (`sv_*`) and manage your cloned voices (`cv_*`, same as **My voices** on the website).

post.description:
Create a translate-and-dub job on the **same pipeline as vmeg.ai**. The first pass renders the dubbed output: poll [Query job status](/api-reference/app-synced/tasks/get-task-detail) until `status` is `finished`, then read `result.outputs[0]`. The job appears in **My tasks** on the website; open `editorUrl` to edit and re-export. Credits follow website pricing.

Differences from Standalone: `options` is optional; `source` takes `materialId` or `youtubeUrl` (no `sourceUrl`); `taskType` must match the material (`vt` video, `at` audio); `title` sets the job name on the website; `output` and `extraData` are rejected with `400`; burned-in subtitles use `options.subtitle` instead of `text`; results are polled, not delivered by webhook. Other unknown fields are ignored.

200.description: Task accepted. `editorUrl` opens the job in the website editor.

post.description: Clone a voice from a reference recording. The call is synchronous and returns when cloning finishes, which can take tens of seconds, so use a generous client timeout (for example 120 s). The voice is saved to **My voices** on the website and returned as `cv_*`; use it in `voiceSpeakers.selectedVoicesList`. `sampleLanguage` defaults to `en-US`; the engine is chosen automatically when `provider` is omitted. Requires a plan with voice cloning (`403` otherwise).

get.description: Paginated video/audio translation jobs in your VMEG account, including jobs created on the website. `status` is `running`, `finished`, or `failed`.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Task ID (same as the job ID on the website)

get.description:
Poll one job. When `status` is `finished`, `result.outputs[0]` is the latest rendered file.

`finished` is not permanent: re-exporting in the website editor sets the job back to `running`, and a failed re-export ends in `failed`. Earlier renders stay in `result.outputs`; `result.outputs[0]` is always the latest successful one.

post.description: Delete a job from your VMEG account. It also disappears from **My tasks** on the website (this applies to jobs created on the website too) and cannot be undone. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency).

Single-file upload **step 1**: get a presigned PUT URL and `materialId`. PUT the file to `uploadUrl`, then call [Complete single-file upload](/api-reference/app-synced/assets/materials/complete-upload). If `material` is returned, the same file is already in your library and no upload is needed. Required unless you create the job from `source.youtubeUrl`.

Uploads are de-duplicated by `fileHash`: uploading a file that is already in your website library returns the existing material, and deleting that material also removes it from **My assets**.
Single-file upload **step 3**: register the file after the PUT succeeds and get the material back. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency).
Multipart upload **step 1**: start an upload and get `materialId` and `uploadId`. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency).
Multipart upload **step 2**: presigned URL per part. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). Flow: [Material upload](/guides/app-synced/overview).
Multipart upload **final step**: commit parts and register the material. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). Flow: [Material upload](/guides/app-synced/overview).
Cancel an in-progress multipart upload. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). See [Material upload](/guides/app-synced/overview).

subtitleMaterialId.description: Optional `.srt` material with the source-language subtitles. Other file types return `400`.

targetSubtitleMaterialId.description: Optional `.srt` material with the translated subtitles. Other file types return `400`.

AppMediaTranslationVoiceClone.description: Automatic dubbing settings (optional). Omit to use website defaults.

style.description: `emotional` (default) | `consistent` clone the original voices; `auto` lets VMEG decide; `tutorial` / `drama` are content presets; `smart` matches preset voices.

mode.description: role | mix | sentence. Only for `emotional` / `consistent`; optional.

provider.description: Clone engine (`V1`–`V5`). Only for `emotional` / `consistent`; optional. See [Supported clone methods](/guides/supported-clone-methods).

AppMediaTranslationOptions.description: Pipeline options (all optional). Voice rules match the website: `voiceClone.style` picks automatic dubbing; `voiceSpeakers.selectedVoicesList` picks voices manually (`sv_*` system, `cv_*` your cloned voices) and cannot be combined with `voiceClone`. `dubbingVersion: V2` cannot be combined with either. Leave `voiceSpeakers.timbreMethod` empty when you set voices; a conflicting value returns `400`.

dubbingVersion.description: Dubbing version, same as the website. `V1` (default): mature and reliable, auto-match a voice or choose one yourself. `V2`: more natural voices and richer emotions; it picks voices automatically, so it cannot be combined with `voiceClone` or `voiceSpeakers.selectedVoicesList`.

lipsync.description: Lip sync on the dubbed video. Requires width and height of at least 360 px, same as the website; lower-resolution materials return `400`. YouTube sources are not pre-checked; make sure the video is at least 360p.

AppMediaTranslationSubtitle.description: Burned-in subtitles (video translation only). Omit to render without subtitles, same as the website default. Replaces the Standalone `text` field; sending `text` returns `400`.

type.description: `none` no subtitles | `target` translated | `origin` original | `multi` both. When omitted: `target` if `templateId` is set, otherwise `none`. Audio translation accepts only `none`.

templateId.description: Style from [List subtitle templates](/api-reference/app-synced/media-translation/list-subtitle-templates). When omitted, the website's default style (the first template in the list) is used.

taskType.description: `vt` video translation | `at` audio translation. Must match the material type, otherwise `400`.

language.description: Source and target locales for localization

title.description: Job name shown in **My tasks** (max 255 characters). Defaults to the file name or the YouTube video title.

editorUrl.description: Website editor URL for this job (sign in with the same VMEG account)

voiceName.description: Display name for the cloned voice in your asset library

refAudio.description: HTTPS reference audio URL (use `refAudioMaterialId` for uploaded files). Provide exactly one of the two.

refAudioMaterialId.description: Material ID of an uploaded audio/video file

videoUrl.description: Dubbed video URL (empty for audio translation)

lipsyncVideoUrl.description: Lip-sync video URL when lip sync is enabled

taskId.description: Task ID (same as the job ID on the website)

editorUrl.description: Website editor URL for this job (sign in with the same VMEG account)

userMessage.description: Failure reason when `status` is `failed` (same text as the website)

materialId.description: Material ID from presigned upload. See [Materials](/guides/app-synced/overview)

fileHash.description: MD5 hash of the uploaded file (must match upload request)
